title: [GMCP 203.013.01] Contract: MRTR, elicitation, sampling, and roots interaction model
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-013-01. Translate the mastery target into a normative clause and behavior table. Pin source revisions and hashes; define canonical APIs and data models, compatibility and deprecation decisions, threat model, measurable SLO or resource budgets, positive and negative fixtures, and immutable evidence locations. Resolve every ambiguity before implementation. Vector outcome: The model-request/tool-response flow fully implements input_required, typed inputRequests, retry with inputResponses, nested elicitation, sampling and roots compatibility, cancellation, deadlines, progress, partial failure, and explicit handle ownership. Every human or model decision is attributable, policy-checked and resumable, and replays cannot duplicate side effects or hijack another principal's handle. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
